payload.name: Contrast Effects
payload.fact: In multiple reinforcement schedules, responding in one component is influenced by the reinforcement rate in other components.

provenance.title: ON THE LAW OF EFFECT<sup>1</sup>
provenance.quote_or_locus: for multiple schedules (i.e., successive discrimination procedures), there are contrast effects between responding in each component and reinforcement in the others
